senses.gloss:
ऋते, ind. except, excepting, with the exception of,
to the exclusion of, besides, without (with abl. or
acc.); sometimes used at the beginning of a com-
pound, e. g. ऋते-रक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, (any rite &c.)
from which the Rakṣasas are excluded.
—ऋते-
कर्मम्, ind., Ved. acting according to fixed rule
or settled law; (Sāy.) granting rain.
—ऋते-जा, आस्,
आस्, अम्, Ved. living in truth, true to the law.
ऋते ऋते. See under ऋत, p. 180.

ऋतेन, ind. according to settled law, duly, properly,
rightly, regularly, in the prescribed manner, justly,
strictly, fairly, truly, honestly.
